u0: Initial state: no non-exit step carrying the box has been credited yet, and the box is not currently held at the point of evaluation. Next objective: if possible, pick up the box and carry it while not at the exit to advance toward the two-carry bonus; otherwise proceed to the exit for the base reward. Reaching the exit from here always ends in u3.
u1: One non-exit step carrying the box has been credited. The box may or may not still be in hand now. Next objective: if the box is held on another non-exit step, advance to u2 for the extra carry credit; if the box has fallen or been dropped, either pick it up and continue carrying or proceed to the exit. Exiting here is terminal: reward is higher if the box is held at the exit.
u2: The carry requirement is complete: the box has been held on at least two non-exit steps. The box may be held or lost now. Next objective: reach the exit; any exit arrival ends the episode in u3, regardless of whether the box is currently held.
u3: Terminal state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode is over. The carry condition at the exit has already determined the final reward; there is no further objective or transition.
